behavior.trigger: Refresh the current scoped purchase list once, immediately after advertisement-link persistence is acknowledged and the original actor/company/vehicle/view context is still current. Official and externally confirmed matches share the same path.
behavior.renderer: Reuse the existing guarded list renderer and Encar icon in both table and cards. No new request, page navigation or detail close is required.
behavior.preservation: Retain search, filters, sorting, page, view mode, peer vehicles, prices and unsaved detail drafts.
behavior.failures: No refresh before an ACK, on failed/unconfirmed storage or after context changes. Successful save retry refreshes once. Missing/throwing renderer cannot undo an acknowledged save or cause another write.
behavior.priceRegression: Existing price-save list refresh and price-confirmation behavior remain intact.

liveListChecks: zero icons while the server write is held
actual table and card icon appear while original detail stays open
exact canonical link and no icons on peer vehicles
memo and extra drafts retained but not saved
failed save then successful held retry
late ACK cannot repaint another detail

production.deployment: Exact source and production merge Cloudflare s-note checks are recorded in the private final receipt.

limitations: Browser tests use synthetic lookup/authentication/database responses. They verify the real frontend and persistence bridge; they do not claim a new live upstream discovery verification.
This release updates the originating current purchase view after its own successful link save. Cross-account push notifications and cross-tab subscriptions are unchanged.
